verdict.rationale: ADK's docs say an official Agents CLI can scaffold, build, test, evaluate and deploy agents from an AI-enabled developer environment. They also say coding assistants can connect to ADK developer Skills, which covers the core of the story. However, the evidence never shows the actual scaffold command or that it runs in one step. The shown `adk` commands (run, web, eval, deploy) operate on existing agent folders. Missing for 10: a documented one-command scaffold invocation, template details, and hands-on or independent corroboration of a coding agent driving the scaffold.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a coding agent scaffold a new agent project from an official CLI or template in one command

citations.quote: Use your favorite AI-enabled developer environment to scaffold, build, test, evaluate, and deploy with Agents CLI.
Connect your favorite coding assistant to our ADK developer Skills and AI-aware developer resources
Create your first Python ADK agent in minutes.
